issues.description: The problem statement requires the Animal name getter and setter to use protected visibility, but the provided solution implements getName() and setName() as public methods. This mismatch between specification and solution can confuse students about the expected visibility and inheritance/access semantics they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the mismatch by choosing one visibility and applying it consistently: either update the problem statement and UML to require public getName()/setName(), or change the solution (and any reference implementations/tests) so Animal.getName() and setName() are declared protected. Ensure the template, specification, UML diagram, and solution all use the same visibility to avoid student confusion.
